_comment: Split-sample closure input for the pair-split unfolding (AN-25-039 unfolding-section TODO): the same aligned-lattice pair_split fiducial and axes as the *_minimal_rho_pairsplit_allsyst.json sibling, run in rho_split mode (nominal jets and weights only). rho_split mirrors zjet's minimal_rho_fine_split: the rho reco/gen/response hists carry a jk axis with two disjoint halves of the events (chunk index % 2 == 0 -> jk=0, == 1 -> jk=1), each normalized by the full-sample sumw, so the two halves are statistically independent. Consumed by unfold/scripts/diagnostics/study_pairsplit_split_closure.py.
